caption: The drawing depicts a single, hexagonal, metallic container or vessel placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The vessel has a broad open top that narrows slightly towards the bottom. Its exterior surface displays a mottled brown color with patches of blue and green that suggest oxidation or patina, indicating a metal such as copper or bronze. The inside of the vessel shows vertical ridges or fluting, and the rim appears uniform and angular, following the overall shape. There are no additional objects or embellishments depicted; the focus is solely on the vessel. The artist's signature, “W. HECKROTH,” is located near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Crockery Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
